lines: Telo Ride is dark beside the bike. A device that asks for light gets light.
From the very first paint. The page used to open dark and flip to light a moment later; now it paints the device's theme before the app has run.
Every text colour is measured on every surface, in both themes. Three pairs read four point four eight to one; now they all pass four and a half.
Match device is still the default, and Dark or Light in Settings holds whatever the device asks.
A ride in light: the same role tokens, never a raw colour.
Home in light, from a phone to the full screen.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
